messages:
maya liu: Quick follow-up from the gen-serve-25 postmortem. I'm consolidating action items and owners — please ack and paste Jira IDs. TL;DR: KV-cache eviction + autoscaler mis-config -> sustained latency spike and 5m of errors. Need short/med/long fixes and runbook updates.

alex roberts: Ack. I'll take the short-term config/GCLT changes and the hotfix rollout. I'll create INF-4241 and link the patch. Target: patch in staging by tomorrow EOD, prod canary after QA.

jun park: I can be backup for the hotfix + own the load/regression test suite changes. I'll open INF-4243 for the test infra and schedule perf run. Tentative due date: 2026-03-29.

sarah ng: I'll own runbooks and postmortem doc edits. Creating INF-4240 for runbook + runbook QA. Will add playbook steps for cache eviction detection and runbook alert thresholds.

maya liu: RACI proposal: Responsible (R) = alex for hotfix, jun for tests, sarah for docs; Accountable (A) = maya for closure; Consulted (C) = eng-sre (ops-scheduler) and runtime team; Informed (I) = CS + product. Please reply if that looks off.

alex roberts: That RACI works for me. For handoffs: I will own creating the hotfix branch and the canary plan. @jun will review the canary results and merge. I'll tag INF-4241 -> INF-4243 in the tickets.

incident-bot: [automated] Postmortem 'gen-serve-25' published: https://redwood.slack/pms/gen-serve-25 (internal).

ops-scheduler: Scheduling follow-up review: proposed slot Thu 2026-03-26 10:00 PT. I'll create calendar and invite RACI leads. If that conflicts, shout here.

jun park: Thu 10:00 PT works. I'll bring perf-run logs and a draft test plan.

sarah ng: Added checklist to INF-4240, will do a doc review by Mon 2026-03-23.

maya liu: Awesome — finalizing action list here so we have a single source to paste into the postmortem and Jira board. Please copy/paste your ticket numbers if they differ.

maya liu: ACTION ITEMS:
```
- INF-4241 (alex roberts) — Hotfix: increase GC thresholds, adjust autoscaler cooldowns, rollout canary. Due: 2026-03-23. R: alex, A: maya, C: jun, I: eng/sre.
- INF-4243 (jun park) — Perf/regression tests: add memory-aware batching tests, simulate KV-cache churn. Due: 2026-03-29. R: jun, A: maya, C: alex, I: runtime.
- INF-4240 (sarah ng) — Runbook + postmortem doc updates: detection thresholds, playbook steps, paging escalation. Due: 2026-03-23. R: sarah, A: maya, C: eng-oncall, I: CS.
- INF-4242 (maya liu) — Long-term: evaluation of memory-aware batching + quantization tradeoffs; includes model/serving benchmark. Draft plan due: 2026-04-12. R: maya, A: product, C: research.
```

maya liu: Please react with :white_check_mark: when you've created or linked the Jira ticket and confirm the due date. I'll update the postmortem doc and set these as follow-ups in the board.

alex roberts: :white_check_mark: INF-4241 created -> https://jira.redwood/INF-4241, due 2026-03-23. I'll start the staging rollout tonight.

jun park: :white_check_mark: INF-4243 created -> https://jira.redwood/INF-4243. Added test plan outline.

sarah ng: :white_check_mark: INF-4240 created -> https://jira.redwood/INF-4240. Assigned doc reviewer.

maya liu: Thanks all. I'll run the Thu follow-up and close items once QA verifies prod canary. Noting recurring pattern: similar KV-cache evictions in Feb (INF-4099) — adding that to INF-4242 for trend analysis. If anyone needs to reassign, ping here so I can update the RACI.
